models.name: Bonsai 2 9B
models.why: Ternary 9B in ~2GB. PrismML's report: up to 179 t/s on an M5 Max Pro via MLX and up to 34 t/s on an iPhone 18 Pro Max; upstream llama.cpp loads only the Q2_0 file, the ternary GGUF packings need PrismML's fork.

engines.quant: ternary weights (-1/0/+1); ~2GB footprint; vendor figure (PrismML), not independently verified

engines.quant: NVFP4 (~493GB weights), 8,192-token context; Apple MLX distributed inference
